evidence_class: MEASURED (Vitis HLS 2020.2 csim+csynth); 10 ns; -DHLS_USE_AP_INT (ap_int<10>/<32>/<20>); part xc7z020clg400-1
note_on_target: xc7z020clg400-1 is a PROVISIONAL measurement target (usable margin); NOT the final selected board. Numbers are C-synth ESTIMATES, core only (no DMA/PS/bitstream); interval~=latency because the top is ap_ctrl_hs (no window overlap).
model_invariants_preserved: SEQ=1024,D=32,NHEAD=4,DFF=64,CH=8,weights,int10/Q40 scales,LUTs,class IDs,tensor order,AXI iface,golden vectors; full O(SEQ^2) softmax attention; bit-exact

stage0_cycle_attribution_v3_measured.prequery_note: input+pe+K proj(1.05M)+V proj(1.54M); MUST complete before any query (every query reads all keys)

stage0_theoretical_lower_bounds_ANALYTIC.disclaimer: PROJECTIONS, not measured. interval=latency without query pipelining.
stage0_theoretical_lower_bounds_ANALYTIC.gate_conclusion: Even the full unchanged-architecture stack (score II=1 + 4-head parallel + query DATAFLOW + finish split + FF unroll) floors at ~3.9M cycles (gap ~1.9x) and CANNOT reach 2,048,000, because the serial K/V-projection prefix (~2.88M) alone nearly exhausts the budget. Reaching real-time additionally requires accelerating the K/V (and FFN) projections -> a much larger, higher-risk redesign. The ~1.05M memory-bandwidth floor is not realizable while K/V generation stays a serial rolled prefix.

measured_variants.name: T1 K-banked (score II=1)
measured_variants.change: cyclic-partition k factor 8 + in-scope k write -> score loop II 4->1 (200-885 K-port warning removed)

measured_variants.name: T2 +shared ctx requant

not_implemented_this_session.T3_head_parallel: ANALYZED not built: needs K/V partition factor 16 (2 heads) or 32 (4 heads) + head-loop unroll; projected S2/S3 = 21.6M/16.3M (gap 10.6x/8.0x) -> still far from real-time; deferred per stop-condition (cannot reach target without dataflow).
not_implemented_this_session.Stage4_query_DATAFLOW: ANALYZED not built: the only route below ~4M, but gate shows floor ~3.9M > target due to serial K/V prefix; high risk of 2020.2 code-transformation stall (seen previously with partitioned-pointer boundaries). Requires K/V+FFN projection acceleration to approach 2.048M.
not_implemented_this_session.Stage5_key_lane_parallel: not needed before dataflow; would risk denominator ordering/exactness.

selection.fastest_fitting_bit_exact: T2 (or T1) — interval 32.86M (T2) / 32.84M (T1) cycles; T2 preferred for its LUT/FF headroom (LUT 41.6%) at equal latency
selection.reason_not_achieved: interval=latency (no cross-query overlap); attention is O(SEQ^2)=1024^2 and the K/V-projection serial prefix (~2.88M) alone exceeds the 2.048M budget. Within-query optimizations (T1/T2) cut the score bottleneck but cannot break interval<<latency.
selection.smallest_next_justified_change: Query-loop DATAFLOW (split attention into bounded hls::stream stages, pipelined across the 1024 independent queries) + 4-head parallelism + K/V (and FFN) projection acceleration. Even then real-time is marginal (~2-4M); if 2.048M must be met, a scope change (e.g. accepting a larger interval, or overlapping window acquisition with compute) may be required. This is high-risk on Vitis 2020.2 and should be a dedicated follow-up.

timing_caveat: Estimated (C-synth) only: target 10 ns, estimated clock 8.468 ns (T1/T2), HLS slack +1.17 ns. Post-implementation timing UNRESOLVED. Not board-ready.
